locale.description:
If not specified, the `locale` will be infered from the `Content-Language` header from the `completed` URL.
 In case of multiple locales, only the first one will be considered and it will be converted to snake case.
 For example, if the `Content-Language` header from the `completed` URL returns `en-US, de, bn`, it will be inferred as `en_US`.
 If the `locale` is not specified and there is no `Content-Language` header, this will default to `en_US`.

mimeType.description:
If not specified, the `mimeType` will be inferred from the `Content-Type` header from the `completed` URL.
 If the `mimeType` is not specified and there is no `Content-Type` header, this will default to `text/html`.

If `workflow_id` is present and the workflow has step duration, then either `start_at` or `due_at` is required. If both `start_at` and `due_at` is provided with a `workflow_id` that has step duration, then the `start_at` field will be ignored.

title.description: Title of the task. If not provided. it will be populated by the work request title.

due_at.description: Due date of the task, in ISO 8601 UTC format (2022-12-31T06:00:00Z)

start_at.description: Start date of the task, in ISO 8601 UTC format (2022-12-01T06:00:00Z)

assignees.description: List of users assigned to the work request

priority.description: Update the priority of the work request

status.description: Update the status of the work request

default_value.description: List of the custom field choices

is_required.description: Indicates whether a custom field is required
Indicates whether a label is required

is_required_at_task_creation.description: Indicates whether a label is required at task creation

is_flexible.description: Indicates whether the workflow is flexible

is_active.description: Indicates whether the workflow is active

is_asset_approval_enabled.description: Indicates whether the asset approval of a workflow is enabled

is_resource_management_enabled.description: Indicates whether the resource management of a workflow is enabled

is_smart_duration_enabled.description: Indicates whether the smart duration of a workflow is enabled

actions.description: List of actions of a sub-step

assignees.description: List of assignees of a sub-step

is_user_interaction_allowed.description: Indicates whether the user interaction is allowed

external_system.description: Name of the external system if the substep is external

is_external.description: Indicates whether a substep is external
